name: Slite
description:
Bring your team's trusted knowledge into Claude with Slite. Search Slite documents and workplace sources connected to Slite, get cited answers, and create, edit, or organize structured documentation without leaving the conversation.

Slite Agent adds multi-step research across company context. It keeps context across follow-up requests, compares evidence from multiple sources, and turns findings or conversations into drafted documentation and focused updates for human review. You can also manage comments, collections, and workspace content.

Access uses OAuth 2.0 and respects each user's existing Slite permissions. No API keys, local server, or configuration files are required.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Slite to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Slite to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.slite.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Slite MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Slite lists 41 MCP tools, including append-blocks, archive-note, ask-slite, create-channel, create-collection, create-comment-thread, create-note, edit-document, get-comment-thread-on-note, get-note, get-note-children, and get-user.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Slite?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Slite in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Slite requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Slite is developed by Slite. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
